templates.name: 발진 · 5단 CMOS 링 클록
templates.scope: 10개 실제 SKY130 MOS · 5단 지연 링 · 외부 클록 없음 · 이상적 단계 부하
templates.model_scope: SKY130 MOS with ideal external R/C; deterministic transient, no noise/jitter qualification

references.title: Understanding Schmitt Triggers (SCEA046B)
references.venue: Official application brief, not a silicon result
references.read_scope: Full PDF pages 1-3, hysteresis thresholds and slow-input current discussion, accessed 2026-10-16
references.technology: Commercial logic-family explanation; our custom SKY130 topology is independently authored
references.adopted: Separate measured upper/lower switching levels and include real supply current; avoid assuming ideal noise immunity.
references.not_reproduced: TI device topology, threshold specifications, phase noise, jitter, ESD or measured silicon performance.

references.title: Relaxation Oscillator Circuit (SNOA998A)
references.venue: Official Analog Engineer circuit note, not a research reproduction
references.read_scope: Full PDF, design description and RC/threshold equations, accessed 2026-10-16
references.technology: 5V discrete comparator design; not our 1.8V CMOS circuit
references.adopted: Independently derive exponential RC period using measured switching levels; expose feedback loading and MOS delay assumptions.
references.not_reproduced: TLV3201 comparator, 1MHz specification, component values or published performance. Our resistor-feedback MOS circuit differs.

research.relationship: method-inspired review; existing owned circuits, not a reproduction of the cited chips
research.qualification: not-run; actual revision-bound engine results are required
pending: Thermal/flicker noise and mismatch yield except explicitly executed studies.
Full PVT/RC, EM/IR, ESD, antenna/density, foundry signoff.
Complete sequential timing, STA/Liberty and physical CPU/ADC-controller closure.

limits: Actual native schematic and public ngspice models; no commercial execution claim.
Empty layout is not physically verified.
Independent native DRC/LVS/PEX required. Reference routing is not foundry signoff or an HD standard-cell/Liberty library.
